dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are Dandelion Seeds all you need?

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: Yes, they will suffice. The other flowers in Mondstadt do not scatter in to the distance very well, in any case.

dialogues.speaker: Grace
dialogues.text: So please do help me get a batch of Dandelion Seeds. I will wait here for you.
